en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Piercing the ear of the boy is from the Sunnah, and circumcision of the boy is from the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Piercing the ears of a boy is of the Sunnah as well as his circumcision.’”
